title: Jeska's Final Sacrifice at Otaria
summary: Jeska protects Radha and Venser and gives her life to seal the final rift.
narrative: The damage associated with Karona culminated in a final, exceptionally dangerous fracture over Otaria.
Rather than sacrifice Radha and Venser, Jeska sent them away and spent her own power and life to close the wound, completing the Mending.
